<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Beleg Tâl" /></noinclude>{{verse|26|16}} But riſe, and ſtand vpon thy feete: for I haue appeared vnto the thee for this purpoſe, to make thee a miniſter and a witneſſe, both of theſe things which thou haſt ſeen, ⁊ of thoſe things in the which I will appeare vnto thee, 

{{verse|26|17}} Deliuering thee from the people, and {{smaller|from}} the Gentiles, vnto whom now I ſend thee, 

{{verse|26|18}} To open their eyes, {{smaller|and}} to turne {{smaller|them}} {{smaller|from}} darkneſſe to light, and from the power of Satan vnto God, that they may receiue forgiueneſſe of ſinnes, and inheritance among them which are ſanctified by faith that is in me.<noinclude></noinclude>
